"""Application state management."""

import collections


class ApplicationState:
    """Encapsulates shared state previously in g.py."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.metadata = {}
        self.artist = ""
        self.album = ""
        self.scrobble = False
        self.scrobble_queue = []
        self.lastfm_network = None
        self.detectable_size = True
        self.command_line = False
        self.debug_mode = False
        self.preload_disabled = False
        self.ytpls = []
        self.mpv_version = (0, 0, 0)
        self.mpv_options = None
        self.mpv_usesock = False
        self.mplayer_version = 0
        self.mprisctl = None
        self.browse_mode = "normal"
        self.preloading = []
        self.no_clear_screen = False
        self.no_textart = False
        self.max_retries = 3
        self.max_cached_streams = 1500
        self.username_query_cache = collections.OrderedDict()
        self.model = None  # Will be set to a Playlist instance by caller
        self.last_search_query = (None, None)
        self.current_page = 0
        self.result_count = 0
        self.rprompt = None
        self.active = None  # Will be set to a Playlist instance by caller
        self.userpl = {}
        self.userhist = {}
        self.pafs = collections.OrderedDict()
        self.streams = collections.OrderedDict()
        self.pafy_pls = {}
        self.selected_pafy_pls_id = ''
        self.last_opened = ""
        self.message = ""
        self.content = ""
        self.suffix = "3"
        self.categories = {
            "film": 1,
            "autos": 2,
            "music": 10,
            "sports": 17,
            "travel": 19,
            "gaming": 20,
            "blogging": 21,
            "news": 25,
        }
        self.playerargs_defaults = {
            "mpv": {
                "msglevel": {
                    "<0.4": "--msglevel=all=no:statusline=status",
                    ">=0.4": "--msg-level=all=no,statusline=status",
                },
                "title": "--force-media-title",
                "fs": "--fs",
                "novid": "--no-video",
                "ignidx": "--demuxer-lavf-o=fflags=+ignidx",
                "geo": "--geometry",
            },
            "mplayer": {
                "title": "-title",
                "fs": "-fs",
                "novid": "-novideo",
                "ignidx": "",
                "geo": "-geometry",
            },
            "vlc": {"title": "--meta-title"},
        }
        self.encoders = []
        self.muxapp = False


def make_context():
    """Return an ApplicationState instance with safe defaults."""
    ctx = ApplicationState()
    # Initialize collections that rely on modules already imported
    from .playlist import Playlist
    ctx.model = Playlist(name="model")
    ctx.active = Playlist(name="active")
    return ctx
